subject: general
question: What was the total time taken to draft the Constitution of India?
solution:
Correct answer is __**2 years, 11 months and 18 days.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Constitution process took** 2 years, 11 months, and 18 days**—at a total expenditure of** ₹6.4 million to finish.**
 
• The Republic is ruled in **terms of the Constitution of India** which was adopted by the Constituent Assembly on **26th November 1949** and effective on **26th January 1950.**
 
• The Constitution of India is **the supreme law of India**.
 
• A constitution is a **set of fundamental principles according to which a country can be governed**.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3d72e4622aa4f0774db456aee464e977f847341c7fa360ad56ffd9f76d1dc652.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

​ **Qualities of the Indian Constitution are given below:**

 
• World's Longest Constitution
 
• Independent and Integrated Judicial System
 
• Directive Principles of State Policy
 
• Federal System with Unitary Features
